meta.title: Finding a $2,000 Levi’s Jacket! NYC Thrifting Haul.
meta.description:
Get Levi's 501s here! https://fave.co/3DFMF9A

Oh we thrifting baby! A thrifting haul! NYC! Levi's! Vintage Denim! Ronnie! Amelia! Taylor!

Ah, thrifting. One of those things you do when you go outside and want to find a deal. Well guess what, I did that! Did I find a perfect pair of vintage Levi 501's? What about the perfect Levi's or Wrangler jacket? What about neither of those two? What if this is all just disappointing? What if? I guess we'll never ever know. I did see a lot of cool vintage, selvedge, unsanforized denim though. Deadstock even. Hypebeast level denim.

The Iron Snail is a men’s fashion vlog starring a young man named Michael and featuring a snail no bigger than a quarter. The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jacket to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered. (written by Taylor, though Michael is sometimes known to talk about himself in the third person… xoxo)
